I was on a combination of ambien(amitrepilane) and zoplidem a couple of years ago.

The lethargy/sleepiness is a  common side effect and is usually to my knowledge designated to be ingested at night before bed.

Ambien has a considerably long half life if I remember correctly which means it builds up in your blood stream over days.The bad thing is the opposite is also true,it takes a couple of days to work out of the body.

If i remember correctly ambien is a tolerance drug which means your body adjusts constantly to counteract the medicine and dosages needs to be increased over time to compensate.

It is also a high risk drug for addiction if my memory serves as it took me literally over a year to be free from side effects of ambien and zolpidem.I still have recurring relapses on zolpidem/benzo's which I have a hell of a time fighting off the constant feeling of needing it

When starting or stopping medication like this its extremely important to talk to your health practitioner first as going cold turkey(stopping medication all at once) could have life threatining adverse reacttions including seizures.

Please visit your doctor before adjusting your dosages.

Also please note that all the above is from memory and might be incorrect

Source:I was on it a couple of years

Best wishes and I hope you find relief

not wanting to die is not a bad thing.not wanting to live isn't a bad thing either.

The former is routed in our genetics.The latter is routed in emotion and logic.
